title: Records.
bodyText: The director shall maintain a record of all marks registered or renewed under this part, including a record of all marks recorded pursuant to section 482-26.
bodyHtml: [§482-27]  Records.  The director shall maintain a record of all marks registered or renewed under this part, including a record of all marks recorded pursuant to section 482-26. [L 2001, c 15, pt of §1]
